subject: RFQ: Azure Marketplace Private Plan — onboarding timeline, compliance & invoicing
body:
From: Sarah Blake <sarah.blake@fortuna-fin.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: mark.reynolds@fortuna-fin.com
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFQ: Azure Marketplace Private Plan — onboarding timeline, compliance & invoicing

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Fortuna is preparing an RFQ for a Private Plan listing on Azure Marketplace and we want to align on a few commercial and compliance points before we proceed to the formal procurement pack. Attached is our RFQ (Fortuna_RFQ_20260928.pdf). Key asks:

- Data residency: Production processing and logs must remain in EU regions (Ireland/Netherlands).
- SLA: enterprise SLA with 99.95% uptime and credits for outage windows >15m.
- Price model: monthly committed capacity with overage tiers; invoicing must accept PO-based quarterly invoicing (Net 45).
- Compliance evidence: SOC 2 Type II report or summary, ISO 27001 cert, and a short runbook for onboarding (timelines, handoffs).
- Contract flow: we need a standard DPA + a SOW that can be attached to our PO. Minimal redlines allowed by legal.

Can you confirm if Redwood can: (a) meet EU-only hosting for this private SKU, (b) accept PO-based invoicing with Net 45, and (c) provide the compliance artifacts within 3 business days? Also include an initial onboarding timeline (kickoff -> production) so I can present to procurement.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Blake
Senior Procurement Manager, Fortuna Financial

---

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: RFQ: Azure Marketplace Private Plan — onboarding timeline, compliance & invoicing

Folks — forwarding RFQ from Fortuna. Quick asks: confirm EU-only hosting for private plan, PO-based invoicing feasibility (finance), and whether we can commit to getting SOC2 summary and onboarding runbook within 3 business days.

Laura — can you own the compliance packet? Ben — can you review the pricing ask and draft a 90-day committed capacity quote with monthly billing but PO-friendly terms? Aisha — please prepare an onboarding timeline (kickoff, integration week, validation, go-live) and estimate resource hours. Neha — FYI re: Net 45; finance will need the billing flow documented for the marketplace private offer.

I put a 24h response target so we can get back to Sarah by EOD tomorrow.
Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Cloud Partnerships
Redwood Inference

---

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: RFQ: Azure Marketplace Private Plan — onboarding timeline, compliance & invoicing

Karthik —

We can provide the following:
- EU-only hosting: yes. We can pin the private plan to Azure West Europe (Netherlands) or North Europe (Ireland) and restrict image/region placement through the private plan configuration and our deployment policy. I recommend West Europe for Fortuna's latency profile.
- Compliance artifacts: SOC 2 Type II summary and ISO 27001 cert are available; attaching Redwood_DPA_SOC2_summary.pdf. Full SOC 2 report requires an NDA/process — we can provide the SOC 2 bridge letter within 48-72 hours.
- DPA/SOW: legal can accept limited redlines. I asked Legal to pre-clear a standard carve for PO-based invoicing and Net 45 payment terms; we may need a revenue recognition note for finance.

I will assemble the runbook and an onboarding timeline draft (target 4 weeks from kickoff to production assuming completed integration tasks on Fortuna's side).

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_DPA_SOC2_summary.pdf

---

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: aisha_rahman@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: RFQ: Azure Marketplace Private Plan — onboarding timeline, compliance & invoicing

Quick commercial note:
- Proposed structure: Monthly committed vCPU/GPU pool with a 3-month minimum term, priced at listless discounted rate (see internal quote). Overage: blended per-token/compute rate with step-down tiers.
- Invoicing: We can do PO-based invoicing, but for marketplace private plans we require a billing profile that maps to the customer entity. Finance (Neha) will need the PO number and remit-to details; Net 45 is acceptable but requires a manual billing workflow for the private offer.
- SLA credit: we can support 99.95% SLO. Draft SLA credit language: credits calculated as a percentage of monthly committed fee, pro-rated by outage minutes >15m. Legal to propose exact thresholds.

I will produce a pricing sheet and put together a short commercial summary for Sarah.

Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts

---

From: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
To: Sarah Blake <sarah.blake@fortuna-fin.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 06:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: RFQ: Azure Marketplace Private Plan — onboarding timeline, compliance & invoicing

Hi Sarah — thanks for the RFQ and clarity on requirements. Attached is a proposed onboarding timeline and a high-level SOW with our standard milestones (Proposed_SOW_redlines_v1.docx). Summary below:

Proposed onboarding timeline (typical):
- Week 0: Kickoff + account setup (access, NS/tenant mapping)
- Week 1: Integration & test environment provisioning (network peering, private plan config)
- Week 2: Functional verification + security review (SOC2 artifacts shared)
- Week 3: Performance validation, smoke tests, and cutover planning
- Week 4: Production go-live and monitoring handover

If Fortuna can commit to a single integration point of contact and provide required Azure tenant IDs and network contacts within 5 business days of kickoff, we can meet Week 4 go-live. Estimated Redwood effort: 2 engineer-weeks + 1 solutions engineer + 0.5 PM-week (detailed in the SOW).

For PO-based billing, please include the PO number and billing address on the purchase order. We will submit invoices to the email on the PO and route payment through finance; expect Net 45 processing.

Attachments: Proposed_SOW_redlines_v1.docx

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

---

From: Sarah Blake <sarah.blake@fortuna-fin.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: mark.reynolds@fortuna-fin.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 10:18:00 +0100
Subject: Re: RFQ: Azure Marketplace Private Plan — onboarding timeline, compliance & invoicing

Thanks team — this is helpful. A few clarifications from procurement/legal here at Fortuna:

1) SOC 2: the summary is fine for initial review; procurement requires the bridge letter and either the full report or a signed NDA to receive it. Please send the NDA and we will countersign within 48h.
2) SLA credits: procurement requests the exact credit table (minutes -> credit %) and a cap per month. Can Redwood provide that language so we can run it through legal?
3) PO billing: we will issue a quarterly PO (Q4 commit) with the PO number in the invoice. Net 45 is OK. Please confirm Redwood's remit-to details to include on the PO.

We'd like to move to a commercial term sheet and have finance review the SOW. Can Redwood produce a short one-pager that captures the committed capacity, pricing, invoicing cadence and SLA summary? If so, we can circulate to procurement and legal and target a signature on the PO within two weeks.

Mark Reynolds
VP, Strategic Ops (copied)

---

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Sarah Blake <sarah.blake@fortuna-fin.com>, mark.reynolds@fortuna-fin.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, aisha_rahman@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: RFQ: Azure Marketplace Private Plan — onboarding timeline, compliance & invoicing

Sarah / Mark — appreciate the quick feedback. Next steps from Redwood:

1) Laura will send an NDA and a SOC 2 bridge letter within 24 hours (Laura - please confirm after you send).
2) Ben will attach the commercial one-pager and the SLA credit table as a single PDF for procurement review.
3) Aisha will confirm the onboarding milestones in the SOW and include a short checklist of Fortuna deliverables required at kickoff.
4) Neha will provide remit-to invoicing details for inclusion on the PO: remit-to@redwood.com; Redwood Inference, Inc. — 3458 Midway Ave, San Francisco, CA 94107; Tax ID: 12-3456789. (Neha - confirm if any additional fields are required).

We aim to have the term sheet + SLA table + NDA uploaded to your HubSpot record and a DocuSign-ready PO template by EOD tomorrow so procurement has something to circulate.

If that timeline works for Fortuna, I'll schedule a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk procurement/legal through the SLA and billing flow — propose 09:00 PT / 18:00 CEST.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Cloud Partnerships

---

Notes: Attachments referenced in-thread: Fortuna_RFQ_20260928.pdf, Redwood_DPA_SOC2_summary.pdf, Proposed_SOW_redlines_v1.docx. Internal action items assigned in thread.
